lines.speaker: ben
lines.text: Before I joined the gym, I was tired.

translation.vi: Trước khi mình tham gia phòng gym, mình đã mệt.

lines.speaker: anna
lines.text: How many days a week do you go?

translation.vi: Bạn đi bao nhiêu ngày một tuần?

lines.speaker: ben
lines.text: Three days. I want a strong body.

translation.vi: Ba ngày. Mình muốn có một cơ thể khỏe mạnh.

gloss.en: a place with machines to make the body strong

grammar_notes: Use 'before' or 'after' with a subject and verb to show time order. Example: 'Before I joined the gym, I was tired.'
interaction_prompts: Do you go to a gym? Tell us about your hobby.
